reasons.observed: The first independent closeout-manifest audit assumed a zero_deletions field that the declared schema did not contain and stopped before content verification.
reasons.recovery: Read the manifest's declared fields first, then evaluate its exact entry and exclusion sets without inventing an undeclared property.
reasons.recurrence_guard: Schema-aware audits must inspect declared keys before asserting an optional or version-specific manifest field.

reasons.observed: The corrected independent audit compared raw working-tree bytes against Git-clean manifest hashes and falsely reported two CRLF-normalized Python files as mismatches.
reasons.recovery: Stage the exact declared set and replay sizes and SHA-256 values from index blobs, which are the representation bound by the manifest.
reasons.recurrence_guard: Compare a Git-clean manifest only with staged or committed Git blobs, never raw platform-normalized working-tree bytes.

reasons.observed: The physical pre-canonical document-cap audit found the x1, x2, and final Method Flow ledgers contained 136811, 184082, and 185839 whitespace tokens because retained prose was repeated inline.
reasons.recovery: Preserve every method, witness, state event, recommendation, and prose value through deterministic lossless text references, serialize all three ledgers compactly, and validate every final document at or below 100000 whitespace-delimited words.
reasons.recurrence_guard: Run a physical document word-cap preflight before terminal validation and normalize repeated ledger prose losslessly.

reasons.observed: The first correction build exceeded its five-minute command window because repeated path and owner-manifest passes launched a separate Git clean-filter process for each file.
reasons.recovery: Stop the isolated builder and its Git child, retain the partial attempt at zero credit, then use one in-memory UTF-8 CRLF-to-LF normalization under the verified core.autocrlf=true policy before an exact staged-blob replay.
reasons.recurrence_guard: Never place an external Git process inside a repeated owner-file manifest loop; batch prior blobs and normalize current text once.
